_comment: Frozen base-image pins for TraceWeave-Core, per platform. NEVER edit a digest in place: to change a pin, add a dated entry and bump manifest_version in MANIFEST.md. Every triaged repo records the pinned_ref and platform it actually ran under, so provenance is explicit even across machines.
_active_platform_comment: 'auto' detects from the Docker daemon at runtime (see triage.sh). Set explicitly to 'linux/amd64' or 'linux/arm64' only to force a platform, which will emulate and INVALIDATE ALL TIMING MEASUREMENTS.
_platform_warning: A corpus must be built on ONE architecture. Most Python deps are pure-Python wheels whose versions are platform-independent, so lock_sha256 will often match across platforms -- but any repo with compiled extensions (numpy, lxml, cryptography, pydantic-core) can resolve different wheels and therefore a different lock_sha256. Do not mix platforms within a corpus without re-triaging.
